title: Headless ComfyUI on 127.0.0.1 runs an API workflow of built-in image nodes with no models
summary: ComfyUI v0.46.0 CPU server: POST /prompt of a six-node API graph (load, scale, invert, blend with a generated colour, save); fixed size, four probed pixels, /history entry, loopback-only listener; resubmission byte identity recorded. No models, no custom nodes.
